from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,zipfile,time,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();private=root/'.local/step07/fix-round4';stage=private/'final';source='59423201ba10ee71c3d1b04cebec69659017b7c7';assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==source
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();start=time.time();paths=[]
for d in ['browser-production','browser-dev','restored-browser-complete']:paths+=list((stage/d).rglob('*.zip'))
paths+=list((private/'independent-reference/evidence').rglob('*.zip'))
recovery=json.loads((stage/'broken-recovery-clone.json').read_text());paths.append(Path(recovery['clone']['assets']).parent/'recovered-standard.zip')
rows=[]
for p in sorted(paths):
 with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
  names=z.namelist();assert z.testzip() is None;assert len(names)==8 and set(names)=={'A1.png','A2.png','pack.json','history.json','layout.json','sources.json','INSTALL.md','manifest.json'}
  m=z.read('manifest.json');j=json.loads(m);identity=j['identity'];profile=identity['profile'];assert sha(json.dumps(profile,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode())==identity['profileHash']=='48844001eea07a8cf0da4baf9abb1653b01c38a9405413ed3123df189cf48793'
  for n,r in identity['files'].items():assert sha(z.read(n))==r['sha256'] and len(z.read(n))==r['bytes'],(p,n)
  rows.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'zipSHA256':sha(p.read_bytes()),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'exportBuildId':j['buildId'],'manifestSHA256':sha(m),'artifactSourceSHA':identity['context']['commit'],'profileHash':identity['profileHash'],'allSevenPayloadBytesSHAMatch':True,'safeEightMembersAndCRC':True})
assert len(rows)==12,len(rows)
(stage/'all-standard-zip-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'scope':'Actual downloaded ZIPs; selected-build/network identity separately asserted by real browser/HTTP evidence; old recovered counterexample retains its original context','count':len(rows),'exports':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
with (stage/'commands.jsonl').open('a')as f:f.write(json.dumps({'label':'all-standard-zip-audit','args':['python3','.local/step07/fix-round4/verify-all-zips.py'],'sourceSHA':source,'exitCode':0,'durationSeconds':round(time.time()-start,2),'count':len(rows)})+'\n')
print('12 actual standard ZIPs CRC/eight members/payload hash/Profile verified')
